description: List the energy devices bound to the selected or default site. Return this device list on its own; do not call get_site_dashboard just because the request names a site or asks which devices it contains. If the user separately asks for site-level identity, location, current overview, energy summary, status, or health, also call get_site_dashboard. For a specific device's details or status, use get_device_dashboard without a site dashboard unless site-level information was separately requested.
name: list_site_devices
